## NVIDIA Data Center Revenue: Q2 FY2026 → Q2 FY2027

| Fiscal Quarter | Period Ended | Data Center Revenue | QoQ Growth |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q2 FY2026 | Jul 2025 | $41.1B | — |
| Q3 FY2026 | Oct 2025 | $51.2B | +24.6% |
| Q4 FY2026 | Jan 2026 | $62.3B | +21.7% |
| Q1 FY2027 | Apr 2026 | $75.2B | +20.8% |
| Q2 FY2027 | Jul 2026 | $89.0B | +18.4% |

**Notes**
- Q2 FY2026 Data Center revenue was ~$41.1B (up ~56% YoY).
- Q3 FY2026: $51.2B (vs. ~$49.3B consensus); total revenue $57.0B.
- Q4 FY2026: $62.3B, ~91.5% of total revenue; total revenue $68.1B.
- Q1 FY2027: $75.2B (up 92% YoY), split ~$60.4B Compute / ~$14.8B Networking; total revenue $81.6B.
- Q2 FY2027: $89.0B; total revenue $96.2B (up ~106% YoY).

Every quarter in this span set a record, with sequential growth decelerating gradually from ~25% to ~18% as the base scaled up.

One caveat: these figures come from financial media coverage rather than NVIDIA's own press releases, so the Q2 FY2026 and Q2 FY2027 Data Center values in particular are worth confirming against the official earnings releases.
